statusLine.command: input=$(cat); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ''); git_status=''; if [ -n "$branch" ]; then changes=$(git -C "$dir" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$changes" -gt 0 ] && git_status="*$changes"; fi; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); ctx_display=''; [ -n "$ctx" ] && ctx_display=" | ctx: ${ctx}%"; total_in=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); total_out=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0'); cost_in=$(echo "scale=4; $total_in * 3 / 1000000" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); cost_out=$(echo "scale=4; $total_out * 15 / 1000000" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); total_cost=$(echo "scale=4; $cost_in + $cost_out" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); usage_display=''; if [ "$total_in" -gt 0 ] || [ "$total_out" -gt 0 ]; then in_k=$(echo "scale=1; $total_in / 1000" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); out_k=$(echo "scale=1; $total_out / 1000" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); usage_display=$(printf " | %.1fk/%.1fk \$%.3f" "$in_k" "$out_k" "$total_cost"); fi; time=$(date +%H:%M); printf "\033[35m%s@%s\033[0m \033[31m%s\033[0m" "$user" "$host" "$dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf " \033[33m%s%s\033[0m" "$branch" "$git_status"; printf " \033[36m%s\033[0m \033[34m♥ %s\033[0m%s%s" "$model" "$time" "$ctx_display" "$usage_display"
